title: ADHD Digital Planner 2026 + Undated | GoodNotes Notability iPad | Fillable PDF + Sticker Pack | ADHD Friendly Planner Instant Download
description:
🌿 Finally — a digital planner that actually works with your ADHD brain, not against it! The ADHD-friendly kawaii planner for GoodNotes and Notability designed to help you focus, flex, and celebrate every small win.

Meet the ADHD Digital Planner 2026, your brain-friendly fillable PDF planner for GoodNotes, Notability, and iPad — packed with 130 beautifully designed pages in a calming Matcha Serenity color theme, with low-overwhelm layouts, visual chunking, Pomodoro focus tools, brain dump pages, and body doubling logs — plus a bonus undated version and 200+ kawaii stickers to make planning feel like self-care, not a chore.

🧠 SECTIONS INCLUDED (130 pages)
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
• Welcome & Setup Guide — app links, how-to steps, support contact, and a note on how this planner is built for ADHD brains
• Dashboard / Home — tappable hub linking to every section in one tap
• Planner Index — complete table of contents with page numbers
• Yearly Overview — see all 12 months at a glance without overwhelm
• Monthly Calendars × 12 — spacious month grid with wide daily cells, minimal visual clutter
• Monthly Reviews × 12 — gentle reflection prompts (wins, what drained you, one intention for next month)
• Weekly Spreads × 52 — time-blocking layout with visual morning / afternoon / evening chunking, one priority per time block, open task area, "3 Wins This Week" box
• Brain Dump Pages × 12 — one per month, free-write zone before the week starts; get everything out of your head and onto the page to reduce mental load
• Pomodoro Focus Timer Sheets × 4 — 25-min work block boxes + 5-min break markers, session tally, and a "what I focused on" fill-in; great for body doubling sessions
• Priority Matrix Pages × 4 — Urgent/Important 2×2 grid (Eisenhower Matrix); visually sort tasks so you always know what actually needs doing today
• Body Doubling Log — track your co-working sessions, virtual body doubling calls, accountability partner check-ins, and what you accomplished together
• Medication & Supplement Tracker — morning / midday / evening columns with dose and notes; 31-day monthly grid per page
• Energy Level Tracker — daily energy rating (1–5 scale with kawaii battery icons), space to note triggers and patterns over time
• Weekly Intentions — gentler than "goals": "What do I want to feel this week?", "One thing I'll do for myself", "What can I let go of?"
• Habit Tracker — 31-day grid, 8 customizable rows, satisfying bubble-fill format
• Notes Pages × 4 — lined + dot-grid mix for dumping ideas without structure
• Kawaii Sticker Library × 9 — 300+ illustrated sticker reference sheets

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
❓ FAQ
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
Q: How is this different from a regular digital planner?
A: Every layout decision was made with ADHD in mind. Pages have fewer elements to reduce visual overwhelm, time blocks are chunked visually (not just listed), the Brain Dump page lets you clear your working memory before planning, and the "3 Wins" boxes shift focus toward what you did accomplish — not what you missed. No shame-spiral layouts here.

Q: Does this only work if I'm on medication?
A: Not at all! This planner is designed to support ADHD brains with or without medication. The Pomodoro sheets, Priority Matrix, and Energy Tracker are especially useful when managing ADHD through structure and routine alone.

Q: I never stick with planners. Why will this one be different?
A: Traditional planners are built for neurotypical habits. This one is built for the way ADHD brains actually work — flexible weekly layouts, forgiving monthly reviews, and short daily commitments ("3 Wins") instead of demanding full-page schedules. It meets you where you are.

Q: Can I use the Pomodoro sheets even if I use a different time method?
A: Absolutely. The focus timer sheets are just boxes — feel free to use 30/10, 52/17, or any interval that works for your brain. There's no right way.

Q: Does this work on iPhone?
A: Yes! GoodNotes 6, Notability, and Adobe Acrobat Reader all work on iPhone. GoodNotes gives the best experience on iPad.

Q: Can I print this?
A: Absolutely! Print at home or at any print shop. Works great as a physical binder planner too.

Q: Is this a physical item?
A: No — this is a digital download only. You'll receive a PDF and ZIP file instantly after purchase.

Q: Can I share this with a friend who also has ADHD?
A: This license is for personal use only. Please don't share, resell, or redistribute the files — but feel free to link your friend to the shop!

layout_principles: Maximum 3 tasks visible per time block to prevent overwhelm
Wide margins and breathing space on every page (minimum 15% empty space)
Soft mint on rice-paper neutral — calming contrast, scientifically lower anxiety response than bright white
Visual chunking: morning / afternoon / evening blocks use subtle color fills to create clear sections at a glance
No punishing layouts: weekly pages have no 'did you complete everything?' summary — only a '3 Wins' celebration box
Font size minimum 12pt in all fillable fields — touch-friendly and easy to read quickly
Pomodoro and Priority Matrix pages use icon-driven layouts (not dense text) to lower friction at task start
Body Doubling log validates and normalizes the ADHD body-doubling strategy for focus
adhd_design_notes.color_psychology: Matcha Serenity soft mint (#7EC8A4) is clinically associated with reduced cognitive load and lower cortisol response. Sage and botanical greens promote grounded calm without sedation — ideal for ADHD focus work. Rice paper neutral (#F7F9F3) eliminates the visual noise of bright white backgrounds.
